title: Market morning
text:
The market wakes up early,
before the sun is high.
The sellers shout and call out loud,
"Come here and buy, buy, buy!"

The mangoes glow like sunshine,
the chillies are bright red,
the fish are silver, shining,
the rice is in a bed.

My mum buys beans and bananas,
I carry the bag with care.
We walk back home together
with good things to share.
